effect.name: Motion Blur
effect.description: Smears the image along a line. Point it the way the object is travelling and a fast sprite reads as fast instead of teleporting between frames.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Distance
parameter.description: Length of the smear in texels.

parameter.name: Angle
parameter.description: Direction of the smear in degrees. 0 is to the right, 90 is up.

parameter.name: Trailing
parameter.description: On smears only behind the object, like a real trail. Off smears both ways, which is what a camera shutter does.

parameter.name: Amount
parameter.description: Blends the smear back over the sharp original.
